checkpoint.summary: VALIDATION/HARDENING CAMPAIGN COMPLETE - INTERNAL IMPLEMENTATION + QUALIFICATION. Change 018 (strategy postflight & concurrency hardening) implemented, qualified, folded into openspec/specs/execution-strategy-postflight-hardening/, and archived as openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-22-018-strategy-postflight-and-concurrency-hardening/ with all tasks ticked on executed evidence; only 6.3 commit/push remains for this commit. Campaign scope also covered the post-018 implementation waves (foundation, controller hardening, HTTP semantics, Settings UI, live run-state UI/desktop resilience) which were audited, fixed where needed, and re-qualified. Hardening campaign work: baseline gates green (typecheck/build/lint/diff/OpenSpec strict 18 + fast tier); first real-tier run exposed 18 failures across 3 root causes - fixed: (1) LINEAGE_RECONCILIATION_CONFLICT systemic DAG landing failure (empty cherry-pick tolerance + stagedOriginalShas fast-path), (2) loop state-machine defects (ceilingPending repo-keyed leak poisoning future runs, DRAINING strand on unconfirmed publication during drain, pause-during-drain refusal, resume truthful RUN_NOT_PAUSED 409, per-repo postflight-retry mutex), (3) manifest finalCommitSha stale-SHA anchoring across multi-attempt publish (now always post-manifest-HEAD anchored with preReconciliationIntegrationSha provenance). Second review wave found and fixed: path traversal via runAttemptId on persisted-log endpoint (UUID shape + containment checks, HIGH), permission resolve route could rewrite resolved decisions (resolved_at guard + PERMISSION_DECISION_ALREADY_RESOLVED 409), delete-guard 409 invisible in UI (error banner), resume code BAD_REQUEST -> RUN_NOT_PAUSED. ExecutorService shutdown sweep (pendingRunners intent map + graduation fix), startup orphan sweep, index.ts early signal handlers added. Zod<->JSON-schema conformance guard added (schema-conformance.test.ts, 37 tests) with four documented intentional divergences in TEST-STRATEGY §25 (SHA case leniency, relatedDispatchId nullability, changePath backslash normalization, date-time vocabulary gap). Docs reconciled truthfully across README/ROADMAP/RUNTIME-MODEL/DATA-MODEL/API-CONTRACT/UI-UX-SPEC/TEST-STRATEGY/ARCHITECTURE. Known follow-ups recorded: startRun concurrent-start TOCTOU window (pre-existing, narrowed), ASK resolution does not auto-transition run out of ATTENTION_REQUIRED (user retries turn manually; resolve is curl-only until a UI control exists), STALE_RECOVERABLE scheduler leases not re-consumed by strategies, no unit tests yet for several new executor shutdown paths (integration-covered). External UNQUALIFIED unchanged: ChatGPT authenticated wake, Tailscale phone route, real Kimi/Codex inference burn, authorized OpenCode server.
